question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Pacify
solution:
The correct answer is **'aggravate'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pacify **means to make someone (who is angry or agitated) calm or quiet. (शांत करना)

 
 
• *Example - She had to **pacify** the fussy baby.*
 
 
 
• **Aggravate** means made more serious or worse. (चिढ़ाना या उत्तेजित करना; अधिक गंभीर या बदतर बना देना)
 
 
• *Example - The speech made the situation more **aggravated**.*
 
 
 
• Clearly, both words are **opposite in meaning** so '**Aggravate**' is the most appropriate **antonym.**

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Placate **means making someone less angry or hostile. (तसल्ली देना)

 
 
• *Example - They attempted to **placate** the students with promises.*
 
 
 
• **Assuage **means to make (an unpleasant feeling) less intense. (शांत करना)
 
 
• *Example - The letter **assuaged** the fears of most members.*
 
 
 
• **Quell **means to put an end to a rebellion or disorder by force. (वश में करना)
 
 
• *Example - Extra police force was called to **quell** the disturbance.*
